purpose: Close the real-save read-only acceptance gate for DDV v1.25.3 schema 626 without authorizing mutation or replacement.

prerequisites.realSaveRequirement: At least one unmodified DDV-produced packaged schema626 profile for each platform acceptance actually claimed. A cross-save profile may be used only when its source/build provenance is recorded separately; LastSaveDeviceInfo is diagnostic and is not a build identifier.

protocol: Hash and retain the exact original packaged bytes before any operation.
Open through the canonical P1G codec in read-only mode; require GameInfo, Player, World and exact GameInfo.Version=626.

Bind the attempt to the exact platform target build identity; reject unknown build, wrong identity kind, schema624/625/627, malformed root, duplicate JSON keys, unsafe numbers and unsupported ZIP/envelope states.

Record the decoded structural inventory needed for regression, including top-level keys and hashes/counts for unknown/opaque-preservation sentinels where present. Do not normalize or drop unrecognized fields.
Perform no edit and no encoded replacement generation. Verify the exact original packaged input bytes remain unchanged and no source file is replaced.
Repeat canonical decode/read inspection from a fresh process/session and confirm the same schema/root/opaque semantic projection.

If an ordinary in-game save and cold relaunch sample is available without introducing unrelated gameplay changes, re-extract and compare schema/version plus structural/unknown-field continuity. Classify ordinary game save drift separately from Wand-attributable mutation.

Return exact source hashes, build provenance, codec result, structural comparison and any failure code. A PASS closes production read acceptance only; it does not authorize encode-copy, local writer, persistent replacement, or product Apply.

required: real DDV-produced packaged save opens successfully
unknown/opaque observed data is semantically preserved by read-only inspection
optionalWhenAvailable: ordinary game save then re-extract comparison
